snippet.title: Clone. Optimize. Sacrifice.  Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready for an all new adventure with my newest game "Clone. Optimize. Sacrifice."  

Build a city of science and magic, power up cloned heroes through automated dungeons, inherit their strength through cloning, and recycle the rest for science in this casual idle city-builder with deep RPG progression and competitive auto-battle leagues.

Demo coming to steam soon.

Join my discord to join the ongoing beta if interested.

Wish List The Game On Steam~!
 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4800640/Clone_Optimize_Sacrifice/

Discord:  https://discord.gg/WfbXE4cDVA
